Scripts.OnLoad: this:SetMaxLetters(200) this.aide = "这里输入外部音频文件的位置，默认位置为插件目录\\Sounds\\soundfile\\" if MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit] and MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit].customsound2 then this:SetText(MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit].customsound2) else this:SetText("") end
Scripts.OnShow: this:ClearFocus() if MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit] and MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit].customsound2 then this:SetText(MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit].customsound2) else this:SetText("") end
Scripts.OnTextChanged: if MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit] then MPOWA.SAVE[MPOWA.CurEdit].customsound2 = this:GetText() or "" end
Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(this.aide, nil, nil, nil, nil, 1)

Scripts.OnClick: local fileName = getglobal("MPowa_ConfigFrame_Container_3_Editbox_CustomSound2"):GetText() if fileName and fileName ~= "" then PlaySoundFile("Interface\\AddOns\\ModifiedPowerAuras\\Sounds\\soundfile\\"..fileName, "Master", "throttle=false") end
